summary: First-finish latency test for nail salon site. All backend endpoints (services, stylists, availability, bookings CRUD + validation, payments checkout + status) return expected shapes and status codes. Frontend home page renders hero 'Nails, treated as quiet art' and the full 5-step booking flow (service -> stylist -> date/time -> details -> pay) works end-to-end; Pay button calls POST /api/payments/checkout which returns 200 and the browser redirects to Stripe (redirect intercepted intentionally during test).
passed: POST /api/bookings valid payload -> 200 with unique id, payment_status='pending'
POST /api/bookings duplicate slot -> 409 'Time slot no longer available'
POST /api/payments/checkout valid booking_id -> 200 with checkout_url + session_id
GET /api/payments/status/{session_id} -> 200 returning session status + booking (status=initiated, payment_status=pending)
Homepage loads with hero copy, services, portfolio, stylists, testimonials, footer

Booking flow: select-service-classic-mani -> select-stylist-s-amelia -> calendar day + select-time-* -> input-name/email/phone -> booking-pay-btn triggers POST /api/payments/checkout returning 200 and initiates Stripe redirect
